story.title: Cole Kozlowski’s return to UCF murky with latest court decision
story.description: Cole Kozlowski’s return to the UCF football roster took an unexpected turn when a U.S. Court of Appeals issued a stay of an injunction that had previously granted the middle linebacker and other athletes from the Class of 2022 an extra year of eligibility. The ruling, announced Friday, temporarily halts a decision by a U.S. District Court judge three weeks earlier in the Wisne v. NCAA case. An ...
